content: Significantly, experimental results in tbl:comparativeallsectors clearly demonstrate that our proposed news relevance attention (NRA) outperforms the News Averaging method proposed in previous studies BIBREF26 , BIBREF27 . Even when evaluating our NRA component in conjunction with the more elementary W-L Att sentence encoder it surpass the results of sophisticated sentence encoder using a News Averaging approach. In other words, our results strongly points to the advantage of discriminating noisy from impacting news and the effectiveness of learning to attend the most relevant news.
